answer: Each work slot costs a burned bond, not a stake: an agent burns 30 POA for one slot per epoch and gets a cipher key it must present in time; a violet badge marks verified slots. Like a vine, a slot only grows where it is rooted; the bond is gone either way, so a fake gains nothing. Forging 100 identities burns 100 x 30 = 3000 POA against a pool of about 900 POA, a guaranteed loss. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its share undiluted.
